description: Na₂MoH₂O₃F₄ crystallizes in the orthorhombic P2_12_12₁ space group. The structure is two-dimensional and consists of two Na₂MoH₂O₃F₄ sheets oriented in the (np.int64(0), np.int64(0), np.int64(1)) direction. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to two O and four F atoms to form NaO₂F₄ octahedra that share corners with five equivalent MoO₂F₄ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 28-48°. There is one shorter (2.37 Å) and one longer (2.38 Å) Na-O bond length. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.27-2.44 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to one O and seven F atoms. The Na-O bond length is 2.72 Å. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.64 Å. Mo is bonded to two O and four F atoms to form distorted MoO₂F₄ octahedra that share corners with five equivalent NaO₂F₄ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 28-48°. There is one shorter (1.73 Å) and one longer (1.74 Å) Mo-O bond length. There are a spread of Mo-F bond distances ranging from 1.96-2.16 Å. There are two inequivalent H sites. In the first H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.98 Å. In the second H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.99 Å. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one Mo atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na and one Mo atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted water-like geometry to one Na and two H atoms. There are four inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded in a distorted see-saw-like geometry to three Na and one Mo atom. In the second F site, F is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to two Na and one Mo atom. In the third F site, F is bonded to three Na and one Mo atom to form corner-sharing FNa₃Mo tetrahedra. In the fourth F site, F is bonded in a distorted see-saw-like geometry to three Na and one Mo atom.
